title: Supply Chain Traceability
thesis: Snowflake builds plantation-to-refinery chain-of-custody with Dynamic Tables, enables buyer self-service via Iceberg/Athena, and enforces trader-level data segregation — all native SQL, no external blockchain needed

talking_points: Three hundred mills tracked — 97.8% of volume traceable to smallholder level.
Rp 142 trillion in traced export volume this year. Twelve mills below 95% traceability.
150,000 chain-of-custody records maintained in real-time Dynamic Tables.
show: Highlight the 12 mills below threshold on the map
tabs.call_out: 97.8% traceable — but 12 mills below the 95% buyer requirement

transition.line: Let's see which mills have gaps and what's causing them.

talking_points: Full smallholder-to-port chain for every tonne of CPO — built automatically by Dynamic Tables.
Shipment SHP-2024-1247: traced from 28 smallholders through Mill Dumai to Belawan Port.
Mass balance reconciliation flags 7 mills with >5% input-output variance.
show: Click shipment SHP-2024-1247 for full chain visualization
Show the mass balance variance table
tabs.call_out: 7 mills failing mass balance — possible leakage or data gaps

transition.line: The chain is mostly intact. Let's check what auditors see.

talking_points: Row Access Policies enforce buyer-level data segregation — Wilmar sees only their supply chain.
Iceberg Tables enable auditor self-service via Athena — no Snowflake license needed.
Five hundred audit reports searchable via Cortex Search with severity filtering.
show: Show Row Access Policy in action — toggle between buyer views
Demonstrate Athena query on Iceberg table
tabs.call_out: Buyer data segregation + auditor self-service — zero data leakage

transition.line: Now let the VP ask the system in plain language.

talking_points: Budi asks: 'What percentage of our volume is traceable to plantation?'
Cortex Analyst writes the query, returns: 97.8% overall, 12 mills below 95%.
Follow-up: 'What are the top audit findings for mills below 95%?' — agent searches audit reports.
show: Type: 'What is our traceability percentage by mill?'
Switch to advisory mode for audit findings
tabs.call_out: Two AI modes: traceability analytics + audit advisory

talking_points: Seven Snowflake capabilities, six AWS services.
In Snowflake-only mode — Dynamic Tables replace Glue, Row Access Policies replace Lake Formation.
Indonesia is the world's largest palm oil producer — 60% of global output. This traces 300 mills.
tabs.call_out: One platform, native SQL, open Iceberg for auditors

transition.line: That's Snowflake and AWS — better together for palm oil traceability.
